title: D2P Grading Rule Set
description: Content of one immutable revision of a grading rule set artifact (artifactType d2p:grading-rule-set; design decisions ADR-011 §5, ADR-017). Grading is measurement-driven or by explicit point increments; there is no scale rule and uniform scaling is not expressible.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against ("1.0.0" in this release).

artifactId.description: ID of the grading rule set artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision whose content this document is.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (digest profile d2p-digest-v1, computed with this member excluded).

patternRef.description: Pinned revision of the graded pattern.

order.description: Application order of the two stages; required when mode is 'hybrid', forbidden otherwise (schema-enforced).

sizeSystemRef.description: Pinned size system revision. Required when any rule names a sizeKey (D2P-SEM-080, semantic).

baseSizeKey.description: Size key of the base size. Required when any point-increment rule exists (D2P-SEM-080, semantic).

identityEffects.description: Element identity changes caused by topology-changing rules. Omitted when there are none.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

gradingRule.title: Grading rule
gradingRule.description: One grading rule, discriminated by 'kind': measurement-source, parameter-override or point-increment.

measurementSourceRule.title: Measurement source rule
measurementSourceRule.description: Declares where the value of a pattern measurement input comes from per size.

id.description: Stable element ID of the grading rule.

measurementKey.description: Key of a measurement input of the pattern at patternRef.

source.description: Source of the value: the size entry of the size system, or a body measurement profile.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

parameterOverrideRule.title: Parameter override rule
parameterOverrideRule.description: Overrides a pattern parameter with a size-specific expression.

id.description: Stable element ID of the grading rule.

parameterId.description: Element ID of a parameter of the pattern at patternRef.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

pointIncrementRule.title: Point increment rule
pointIncrementRule.description: Moves a point feature by an explicit increment per size, relative to the base size. The target MUST be a point feature (D2P-SEM-080).

id.description: Stable element ID of the grading rule.

pointFeatureId.description: Element ID of a point feature of the pattern at patternRef.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

sizeExpr.title: Size expression
sizeExpr.description: An expression that applies to one size.

sizeKey.description: Size key in the size system at sizeSystemRef.

expr.description: Expression for this size; its dimension MUST match the overridden parameter (D2P-SEM-002).

pointIncrement.title: Point increment
pointIncrement.description: Displacement of a point for one size relative to the base size.

sizeKey.description: Size key in the size system at sizeSystemRef.
